mutations.name: a changesets <pkg>@<digit> destination is not read as a tag
kills: a changesets release tag reads a scoped package tag as a release
handle: a tag push the release shapes spell denies git push origin @scope/pkg@0.3.1

mutations.name: only a scoped changesets tag is read as a tag
kills: a changesets release tag reads an unscoped package tag as a release

mutations.name: -c push.followTags is not read
kills: push.followTags set with git -c reads it set to true as a tag push
handle: a tag push the release shapes spell denies git -c push.followTags=true push origin feat/x

mutations.name: the -c key is matched in its exact letter case
kills: push.followTags set with git -c reads it in another letter case as a tag push

mutations.name: a false or empty -c value still turns followTags on
kills: push.followTags set with git -c leaves it set to false alone
push.followTags set with git -c leaves it set empty alone
push.followTags set with git -c leaves it turned off by the last entry alone
